screen.spacebod_herald.offer.title: The Herald's Printing Press
screen.spacebod_herald.offer.body:
The Herald can write its stories with a small AI model that runs on this computer. It works offline, only ever reads what happened in this world, and writes about once a week in the background. Without it, the paper is still printed from the house templates.

Recommended for this computer: %s (%s download). You can also put any .gguf chat model in the herald-models folder yourself.

screen.spacebod_herald.exchange.none: No notices for you in this edition. The townsfolk will have work for you in the next one.
